opening.argument: The creator presents a custom on-chain contract and token as the vehicle for a rapid trading strategy, instructing viewers to fund it with AVAX and describing the process as an arbitrage attack. The proposed setup requires approximately $200 worth of AVAX, while the speaker reports turning $200 into $1,775 as a successful result. That claimed rapid return is paired with a direct call to “spread the word” and “stack it while you can,” showing active solicitation rather than neutral financial education. The description reinforces the promotional framing by referring to “deploying Contract/Token to mask our arbitrage attack against Pangolin,” while the stated result is presented without extending the claim beyond the reported outcome.
